resources.string: Pro 512×512 DLS UV kits, custom badges & club collections.

DLS Kit Studio stores your custom jerseys, club crests, favorites, and viewing history locally on your device using encrypted Room & DataStore storage. No personal data is collected or sold. Uploaded sponsor or crest images from Photo Picker remain private on your device unless you explicitly share an exported PNG.

DLS Kit Studio is an independent football kit & crest design suite tailored for Dream League Soccer players. Generate authentic 512×512 UV-mapped DLS kit textures, design bespoke club logos, and organize club collections offline.
